onboarding.title: Identity verification
onboarding.placeholder: Coming in Phase 2 -- KYC onboarding wizard (profile, document upload, liveness capture, risk disclosure with signed consent).

error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

profile.title: Tell us about you
profile.description: This information determines the investor category and jurisdiction rules that apply to your account, and starts your identity verification submission.

documents.title: Upload identity documents
documents.description: We need your passport and a proof of address. Files upload directly to secure storage.
documents.proof_of_address_label: Proof of address (utility bill or bank statement)

liveness.title: Liveness check
liveness.description: Take a live selfie so we can match it against your ID document. This runs against our screening provider automatically -- no photo upload from your device gallery.

liveness_error.camera_unavailable: Camera capture isn't supported in this browser.
liveness_error.camera_permission_denied: Camera access was denied. Please allow camera access to continue.
liveness_error.submit_failed: We couldn't submit your liveness capture. Please try again.

disclosure.title: Risk disclosure
disclosure.intro: Before you can invest through Swadely, please read and acknowledge the following risks. This acknowledgment is recorded against your account with a timestamp.
disclosure.market_risk: Tokenized real-world assets are subject to market risk, including the possibility of losing some or all of your invested capital.
disclosure.liquidity_risk: Secondary markets for tokenized assets may be limited or unavailable, and redemption may be delayed or restricted by the asset's terms.
disclosure.regulatory_risk: The regulatory treatment of asset tokenization under IFSCA is evolving and may change, which could affect your rights or the value of your holdings.
disclosure.custody_risk: Underlying assets are held by a third-party IFSCA-registered custodian; custody arrangements carry their own operational and counterparty risk.
disclosure.no_guarantee: Past performance and projected valuations are not guarantees of future results.
disclosure.acknowledgment_label: I have read and understood the risks described above and consent to proceed.
disclosure.submit: I agree and submit for review

status_pending.title: Your application is under review
status_pending.message: We're reviewing your submitted profile, documents, and liveness check. This usually takes a short while -- you'll be able to access the platform as soon as verification completes.

status_verified.title: You're verified
status_verified.message: Your identity has been verified. You can now access the full platform.

status_rejected.title: Verification was not successful
status_rejected.message: We weren't able to verify your identity with the information provided.
